2027-01-12.title: Tuesday after the First Sunday after Denho · Mar Thevodosios the Abbot
readings: The light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ
It is lawful to do good on the sabbath
2027-01-12.alt: Season of Denho. Name day of Bishop Yoohanon Mar Theodosius.
2027-01-12.verse: For it is the God who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
theo: Paul describes his ministry as pure light: “we do not proclaim ourselves; we proclaim Jesus Christ as Lord and ourselves as your slaves for Jesus' sake.” The same God who said at creation, “Let light shine out of darkness”, has shone in our hearts “to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.” In Denho we contemplate that face: the glory of God is not far away but shines in a human face.

In the synagogue a man with a withered hand is placed before Jesus as a test: is it lawful to cure on the sabbath? Jesus answers: you would lift your sheep out of a pit; “How much more valuable is a human being than a sheep! So it is lawful to do good on the sabbath.” He says, “Stretch out your hand,” and it is restored. Today we remember Mar Thevodosios the Abbot, who built monasteries with houses for the sick, the old and the poor beside them: prayer and works of mercy in one place. We pray for Bishop Yoohanon Mar Theodosius on his name day.
outline: Ask: what does the face of a loving person reveal?
The servant points to the Lord.
Point 3 · Do good on the sabbath
“It is lawful to do good on the sabbath.”
live: After Qurbono this Sunday, visit a sick or lonely person.
In one conversation today, speak of Christ, not of your achievements.
2027-01-12.prayer: God of light, you said “Let light shine out of darkness” and shone in our hearts in the face of Jesus. Let us proclaim him, not ourselves, and stretch out our hands to do good. Through the prayers of Mar Thevodosios, unite prayer and mercy in our lives. Amen.
altar: In the Holy Qurbono the face of Christ shines for us in the mysteries. From the altar we go out to do good on the Lord's day.

2027-01-12.question: Does my Sunday include works of mercy?

family.explain: A man had a hand that did not work. Jesus said: stretch out your hand! And it was healed. Jesus said it is always right to do good, even on God's day.

illus: St Theodosius, a monk of Palestine in the fifth century, built a great monastery and next to it three houses: one for the sick, one for the elderly, one for the poor and mentally ill. Monks went from the choir to the wards and back. People called it a city of prayer and mercy.

pm.open: God of light, you shine in the face of Jesus. Shine in our hearts as we gather, and send us out to do good. Amen.
share: God has shone in our hearts (2 Corinthians 4:6). Where has Christ's light reached me?
We do not proclaim ourselves (2 Corinthians 4:5). Do I seek my own glory?
Stretch out your hand (Matthew 12:13). Whom can I help this week?
pm.resp: Lord, let your light shine in us.
interc: For preachers, that they may proclaim Christ and not themselves.
For the sick, the elderly and the poor.
For monks and religious who unite prayer and service.
For Bishop Yoohanon Mar Theodosius on his name day.
For our group, that we may do good on the Lord's day.
pm.close: Father, your glory shines in the face of Christ. Let it shine through us in works of mercy. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Paul says: we do not proclaim ourselves; we proclaim Jesus Christ as Lord and ourselves as your slaves for Jesus' sake (2 Corinthians 4:5). The minister is a window, not a picture.

The same God who said at creation, let light shine out of darkness, has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ (2 Corinthians 4:6). In Denho we gaze at that face.

In the Gospel, they watch to see if Jesus will heal on the sabbath. He asks: which of you would not lift a sheep out of a pit? How much more valuable is a human being than a sheep! So it is lawful to do good on the sabbath (Matthew 12:12). He heals the withered hand.
Mar Thevodosios the Abbot built houses for the sick, the old and the poor beside his monastery. Prayer and mercy belong together. Let our Sundays be days of both. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus healed a man's hand on God's day. Sunday is a good day to help someone! Whom will you help this Sunday?

intro: Theme: “It is lawful to do good on the sabbath.”
The light of God's glory in Christ's face, shining through works of mercy.

sub: A new creation in our hearts.
q: Then God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light.
For it is the God who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
points.apply: Spend a few minutes before an icon of Christ today.

q: Thus says the LORD: Do not let the wise boast in their wisdom, do not let the mighty boast in their might, do not let the wealthy boast in their wealth;
For we do not proclaim ourselves; we proclaim Jesus Christ as Lord and ourselves as your slaves for Jesus' sake.
points.apply: Speak of Christ rather than yourself in one conversation.

sub: A human being more than a sheep.
q: He has told you, O mortal, what is good; and what does the LORD require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?
How much more valuable is a human being than a sheep! So it is lawful to do good on the sabbath.”
points.apply: Do one work of mercy this Sunday.

concl: God's light shines in Christ's face and through our deeds.
Prayer and mercy belong together, as Mar Thevodosios showed.
2027-01-12.resolve: Make next Sunday a day of worship and mercy.
